title: Illustration / Characters / Body types / Repetition
slide_intent: Repeat compatible shapes across a character so its parts feel like one coherent design.
strategic_value: A shared form across head and torso can help Duolingo create recognizable characters with few elements.
demonstration: Six translucent figures compare repeated rounded, circular and tapered shapes, alongside a short note about cohesion.
practical_value: Try repeating a character’s main shape before introducing unrelated forms, then assess whether the result remains distinctive.

content_islands.name: Repeated-form studies
content_islands.spec: Place six blue outlined figures in two rows at left; tint the head and body shapes to reveal repeated forms.

content_islands.name: Optional method
content_islands.spec: Place the Repetition heading and short note at right, preserving the statement that repetition is a starting point rather than a requirement.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly says shape repetition can keep a character’s shape language cohesive.
reference_purposes.Application: The figures demonstrate repeated shapes across different body proportions.

ingredient.name: Shape repetition
ingredient.role: Make a character’s parts feel related.
ingredient.application: Use repeated shapes as a starting point when developing a character.
ingredient.scope: Historical official Duolingo illustration guidance from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot. Repetition is explicitly optional; do not turn the illustrated method into a universal requirement.
